coordinate_system.airport: CSIA Mumbai - Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport

airport_alerts.impact: Use C-wing elevator or stairs. Add 5 minutes to travel time.

airport_alerts.description: High passenger volume at Zone B security
airport_alerts.impact: Expected wait time 15 minutes. Consider Zone A security instead.

gates.description: Gate A1 is located at the far north end of Terminal 1, near the international departures wing. It serves wide-body aircraft including Boeing 777 and Airbus A380 flights.

navigation.landmark_description: Near the large Mumbai mosaic mural, north end of T1 Level 2

route: Proceed to International Check-in Zone A

gates.description: Gate A2 is adjacent to Gate A1 in Terminal 1, positioned right after the first set of escalators. It handles mid-range international routes.

navigation.landmark_description: First set of escalators, A-wing, Level 2, Terminal 1

gates.description: Gate B12 is located in Terminal 2, on Level 2, accessible via the central elevator bank or escalators from the B-concourse entrance. Follow the blue 'B Gates' signs from the security checkpoint. It primarily serves domestic and regional flights.

navigation.landmark_description: Level 2 B-wing, follow blue 'B Gates' signs from T2 security

accessible_route: Use C-wing elevator (B-wing elevator under maintenance)

known_delays.impact: Use C-wing elevator or stairs instead

gates.description: Gate C5 is in the south wing of Terminal 3, accessible via the moving walkway from the main Terminal 3 security exit. It serves low-cost carrier domestic flights.

navigation.landmark_description: South wing of Terminal 3, via moving walkway from main T3 security

accessible_route: Take accessible corridor south (parallel to moving walkway)

gates.description: Gate D3 is at the end of the D-concourse in Terminal 3. It is the furthest gate from security — take the shuttle train from the main terminal or walk 15 minutes. Serves charter and cargo-mixed flights.

navigation.landmark_description: End of D-concourse, Terminal 3. Take shuttle train from T3 main terminal.

route: Walk to shuttle train platform (4 min)
Board shuttle train to D-concourse (4 min)
accessible_route: Accessible path to shuttle train platform

terminals.name: Terminal 1
terminals.description: Terminal 1 is the international departures terminal, handling all intercontinental and long-haul international flights. It features a world-class duty-free mall, premium lounges, and fine dining. The terminal spans four levels connected by escalators, elevators, and moving walkways.

levels.L2: International Departures Check-in, Security, Gates A1-A20
levels.L3: Post-Security Retail, Food Courts, SkyLounge, Business Centre

terminals.access: Enter via the International Departures main entrance on Level 2. Dedicated drop-off zone on ground floor. Sky Bridge connects to the hotel on Level 3.

route: Exit Mumbai Metro Line 1 Sahar Station

from_t2_to_t1.notes: No direct shuttle between T1 and T2. Use taxi or airport transfer service.

terminals.name: Terminal 2
terminals.description: Terminal 2 handles domestic and short-haul international flights. It is modern and compact, designed for fast boarding. It features a food court, shopping, and quick-service lounges. Security is typically faster here than Terminal 1.
terminals.access: Enter via Terminal 2 Departure Hall on Level 2. Shared parking structure with Terminal 1. Shuttle bus connects Terminal 2 to Terminal 3 every 10 minutes.

route: Exit Mumbai Metro Line 1 Sahar Station

from_t2_to_t3.pickup_point: T2 main entrance ground level, Bay 3

terminals.name: Terminal 3
terminals.description: Terminal 3 is a dedicated low-cost carrier and regional terminal. It offers basic amenities with budget-friendly food and retail options. The terminal has two concourses, C and D, with D-concourse served by an automated shuttle train.

levels.L1: Departures Check-in, Security, Gates C1-C10, D-concourse via shuttle

terminals.access: Accessible via the Airport Ring Road on Level 1. Terminal 3 has its own dedicated check-in counters (rows C40-C60). Shuttle bus from Terminal 2 stops at the T3 main entrance.

from_t3_to_t2.dropoff_point: T2 main entrance ground level, Bay 3

services.description: 4 hours of Lounge Access prior to scheduled departure Self Service Food & Beverage Buffet Business Centre Services Free Wi-Fi Open Bar Services 15-minute Complimentary Foot Massage subject to availability

facilities.name: Kids Play Area
facilities.landmark: Adjacent to IndiaMart Convenience Store near Gate B12
facilities.description: A safe, supervised play zone for children aged 2-12. Features soft-play structures, toy stations, and interactive digital games. Monitored by airport staff.

facilities.name: Baby Care Room
facilities.location_description: Terminal 1, Level 2, near Gate A1; Terminal 2, Level 1, near Check-in Hall
facilities.landmark: Near Gate A1 T1 and near Check-in Hall T2
facilities.description: Private nursing and feeding room with comfortable seating, changing table, warm water access, and microwave. Free to use.

route: Baby Care Room immediately beside Gate A1 corridor

facilities.name: Business Centre
facilities.description: Fully equipped business centre with private meeting pods, printing, scanning, video-conferencing facilities, and high-speed fibre internet. Available to lounge members and day-pass holders.

facilities.name: Charging Stations
facilities.location_description: Available at all gates in Terminal 1 and Terminal 2; Terminal 3 near C-concourse entrance
facilities.description: Free multi-standard charging stations (USB-A, USB-C, Type-B, wireless Qi charging pads) throughout all terminals.

facilities.name: Restrooms — Terminal 1 Level 2 (Gate A1/A2 area)
facilities.location_description: Terminal 1, Level 2, midway between Gate A1 and Gate A2
facilities.landmark: Between Gate A1 and Gate A2, Level 2 T1
facilities.description: Premium restrooms with automatic flushing, electronic hand dryers, and vanity stations. Accessible restroom and separate prayer room adjacent.

facilities.name: Restrooms — Terminal 2 Level 2 (Gate B12 area)
facilities.location_description: Terminal 2, Level 2, between Gate B10 and B12
facilities.landmark: Between Gate B10 and B12, Level 2 T2
facilities.description: Fully accessible restrooms with separate male, female, and gender-neutral facilities. Baby changing stations and accessible stalls available.

facilities.name: Restrooms — Terminal 2 Level 1 (Check-in area)
facilities.location_description: Terminal 2, Level 1, near Check-in counters B20-B30
facilities.landmark: Near check-in counters B20-B30, T2 Level 1
facilities.description: Fully accessible restrooms with baby changing stations and lactation room near check-in area.

facilities.name: Restrooms — Terminal 3 D-concourse
facilities.description: Basic restrooms near Gate D3 in D-concourse.

facilities.name: ATM Cluster — Terminal 2
facilities.location_description: Terminal 2, Level 1, Check-in Hall central area
facilities.description: ATM cluster with three banks in T2 check-in hall.

facilities.name: ATM — Terminal 3
facilities.description: Single SBI ATM near C-concourse entrance, Terminal 3.

facilities.name: Baggage Wrap Service
facilities.location_description: Terminal 3, Level 1, near check-in counters C40
facilities.description: Baggage wrapping service to protect luggage during transit.

facilities.name: Family Prayer Room — T1
facilities.location_description: Terminal 1, Level 2, adjacent to Restrooms near Gate A1
facilities.description: Quiet, multi-faith prayer and meditation room. Available to all passengers.

check_in_counters.name: International Check-in Zone A
check_in_counters.description: All international airline check-in counters in Terminal 1, Hall A. Self-check-in kiosks at entrance. Counters open 4 hours before departure.

check_in_counters.name: Domestic Check-in Zone B
check_in_counters.description: Domestic airline check-in counters in Terminal 2. Bag drop available for web check-in passengers. Counters open 2.5 hours before departure.

check_in_counters.name: Budget Carrier Check-in Zone C
check_in_counters.description: Low-cost carrier check-in counters in Terminal 3. Strict baggage weight limits apply. Self-service kiosks near entrance.

baggage_belts.location_description: Terminal 1, Arrivals Hall, Level 0, south end
baggage_belts.description: International arrivals baggage belt for Air India and Emirates long-haul flights. Oversized baggage collection point adjacent to Belt 1.

baggage_belts.location_description: Terminal 1, Arrivals Hall, Level 0, north end
baggage_belts.description: International arrivals belt for British Airways, Lufthansa, and Qatar Airways. Priority baggage arrives first.
Domestic arrivals baggage belt serving IndiGo, SpiceJet, and Vistara flights. Digital display shows assigned flight numbers in real time.
